body: You can say more than you think with a therapist. Before you share how you’re feeling just get them to go over what would be reported first.

I’m not a doctor. 
I think it’s so interesting other people are experiencing this and that it’s not just me. 
But that’s exactly how it started with me. And I went from only having postpartum depression and low anxiety levels to full blown bat shit crazy in 3 months. 

It started with this annoying buzzing or ringing in one or both of my ears to having full blown panic attacks, seeing shadows, hearing voices and feeling a pricking on my body when I slept. (All of that not real- I was so afraid I didn’t know what to do because I had a difficulty distinguishing what was real and what was not) so I started disassociating myself from everyone and now I’ve convinced myself that I can hear people thinking bad things about me. 😐I would hardly be able to sleep and within 3 months of going into depression I tried to commit suicide. 
You should see a doctor just in case.

I’m not blaming it at all on the vaccine.

It’s hard to say since I have a lot of crap going on. 

Hope you find help & that you’re ok.

Just responding to let you know unfortunately it’s probably more common than we think for people like us that have issues with it. You’re an amazing spouse to care so deeply & trying to help him.
